en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a rural landscape with dirt roads, scattered trees, boulders, telegraph poles and a few wooden houses on gently rolling hills. In the foreground is a rocky path and leafless tree; in the distance stand two prominent houses amid forested surroundings. Printed captions in two languages (Swedish and Finnish) appear in the white margin at the bottom.
